pr_title: Fix slider repeats and tails still animating with editor hit animations disabled
pr_body:
Closes #12577.

- [x] Depends on https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/12579.

I've done a bit of reorganisations to how these changes are applied, to hopefully read better. The previous `switch` statement wasn't scaling well with these new cases.

issue_context.title: Slider reverse arrow circle still animated even with hitanimations turned off
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** Reverse arrow circle stills display the expand animation even with Hit animations disabled.

Reproduciable with both the osu!classic skin and default skin in any map.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

| Version | Hit animations ON | Hit animations OFF |
| --- | --- | --- |
| osu!stable | ![Kooha-2021-04-26-00_29_31](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20617307/116025943-048a3080-a628-11eb-9b4b-bfc22628e146.gif)  | ![Kooha-2021-04-26-00_34_37](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20617307/116025955-09e77b00-a628-11eb-9bc4-67226f7559a4.gif) |
| osu!lazer 2021.424.0 (osu!classic skin) | ![Kooha-2021-04-26-00_37_51](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20617307/116026001-25eb1c80-a628-11eb-9884-c05f8b0d9b37.gif) | ![Kooha-2021-04-26-00_38_50](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20617307/116026016-2e435780-a628-11eb-96c5-b31827a017ff.gif) |
| osu!lazer 2021.424.0 (default skin) | ![Kooha-2021-04-26-00_48_07](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20617307/116026458-318b1300-a629-11eb-917c-4fb25f7b9fb3.gif) | ![Kooha-2021-04-26-00_45_49](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20617307/116026467-351e9a00-a629-11eb-98b8-adc69640b080.gif)


**osu!lazer version:** 2021.424.0
